description: Validate that agent output stays within a defined scope contract. Checks allowed/forbidden topics, word limits, and required sections.

output.description: The agent output text to check

allowed_topics.description: Topics the output is allowed to discuss

forbidden_topics.description: Topics the output must NOT discuss

max_words.description: Maximum word count for the output

required_sections.description: Section headings that must appear in the output

name: check_scope_compliance
